title: Checkout request flow
description: Mermaid sequence diagram of a /checkout request reconstructed from the log — auth, cache, and a DB timeout + retry.

sections.name: CheckoutDiagram
sections.description: Emit a sequence diagram from the checkout trace

rules.name: emit-checkout-sequence
rules.match: POST /api/v2/checkout|validating bearer token|token valid|cache MISS|acquired connection|SELECT cart|query TIMEOUT|deadlock retry|committed|write-through key=order|checkout 201
